summary: Older installations get the same safe defaults as new ones, without losing your own choices.

fixes.title: Alert recipients filled in when empty
fixes.text: An installation with no alert recipients now gets its SuperAdmins' mailboxes on the next update. A list you set is never replaced.

fixes.title: Engine starts right after a commit
fixes.text: When PIM Manager may start the engine, the update switches on the immediate start after a commit, as on new installations. Your own setting is kept.

fixes.title: Missing access is named in the update log
fixes.text: The update now checks the access PIM Manager needs on its own resources and names the setup script that grants anything missing.

fixes.title: Installations ahead of their ring stay current
fixes.text: Installations running ahead of their update ring now also get engine sizing, the database size rule and these checks on every update.
